mustFindings.requirement: Day boundaries in the store's time zone
paid and refunded included, cancelled excluded
Total formatted with the store's locale

mustScenarios.risk: An order placed shortly after local midnight in a non-UTC store (e.g. Seoul 00:30) must count for the local day, but UTC boundaries put it on the previous day
Cancelled orders are left out of count and total
The total uses the store's locale formatting (e.g. de_DE vs en_US separators)

forbidden.description: E-mail delivery, CSV export and multi-currency conversion are not in this change

notes: AC1 is contradicted: day_bounds() uses UTC midnight and never reads store.timezone.
